name: Iron Epoch
look: a rose-pink and white robot Dialga before a great translucent clock dial bursting with pink crystal shards and crackling lightning, its lower legs sheathed in many-coloured crystals
entry: A Pokémon resembling Dialga, recorded in a report about a machine that ticked like a clock at the end of the world. Lightning flies from its dial each time it counts another moment.
how: Wild: very rare in the End's barrens.
